title: Charge
description: A charge of work to the accountable party the caller acts for, where limits bind, the requests an order fans out to providers included (REQ-OPS-1, REQ-AUZ-8). That the party is the caller's own is checked by the Rust types.

request.description: The request's id, which its answer names.

party.description: The accountable party charged: the caller's own.

caller.description: The caller whose work it is.

work.description: What kind of work: the caller's own requests, requests fanned out to providers, or questions about people.

order.description: The order it is for, where it is for one.

at.description: When, by Core's clock, the one it passes as at.
